propositions: A removal record for a managed link with no peer confirmation is declined: no UNLINK event is written, the link remains net-active locally, a WARNING is logged, and _inbound_unlink_one returns False
A removal record for a link with a peer confirmation still converges: the link is removed via the named relation only
A local link whose outbound ADD is deduped by an inward same-vendor-type remote link is not removed by an inbound removal record (vendor type collision scenario)
Re-applying the same declined removal record on a later pass declines again idempotently without writing anything
A link whose only confirmation record has source=backfill is removed by a matching removal record in the first post-upgrade pass
When the peer confirmation store is unopenable (None), removal behaves exactly as before this story and no declines occur (fail-open contract)
